Draw a proteomics heatmap

Source: R/Heatmap_tidyHeatmap.R
print.proteomics_heatmap.Rd

Renders the object built by proteomics_heatmap() on the current graphics device, adding the title stored in the object. Printing is what actually draws the heatmap: building it does not.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'proteomics_heatmap'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A proteomics_heatmap object, as returned by proteomics_heatmap().

...

Further arguments passed to ComplexHeatmap::draw().

Value

The drawn HeatmapList, invisibly. Called for its side effect.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("tidyHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  data(nadia_dia)
  res <- process_proteomics(nadia_dia, verbose = FALSE)
  hm <- proteomics_heatmap(res$PCA_Input, mode = "any")

  # Drawing needs a graphics device; send it to a temporary file
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  grDevices::png(f)
  print(hm)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  file.remove(f)
}
